Definition: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pisidia.
BiblicalUsage: Pisidia is a region of Asia Minor where Paul preached on his first journey. He came to Antioch in Pisidia and preached in the synagogue on the Sabbath in Acts 13:14, and passed through Pisidia again on the way to Pamphylia in Acts 14:24.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Pisidia matters because the gospel reached it — a synagogue sermon that turned a whole region toward Christ.
